text_en: “For the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.
text_cn: “天国好像一个家主，清晨出去为自己的葡萄园雇工人。

text_en: After agreeing with the laborers for the usual daily wage, he sent them into his vineyard.
text_cn: 他与工人议定一天一个“德纳”，就派他们到葡萄园里去了。

text_en: When he went out about nine o’clock, he saw others standing idle in the marketplace;
text_cn: 约在第三时辰，又出去，看见另有些人在街市上闲立着，

text_en: and he said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and I will pay you whatever is right. ’ So they went.
text_cn: 就对他们说：你们也到我的葡萄园里去吧！凡照公义该给的，我必给你们。

text_en: When he went out again about noon and about three o’clock, he did the same.
text_cn: 他们就去了。约在第六和第九时辰，他又出去，也照样作了。

text_en: And about five o’clock he went out and found others standing around; and he said to them, ‘Why are you standing here idle all day? ’
text_cn: 约在第十一时辰， 他又出去，看见还有些人站在那里，就对他们说：为什么你们站在这里整天闲着？

text_en: They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us. ’ He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard. ’
text_cn: 他们对他说：因为没有人雇我们。他给他们说：你们也到我的葡萄园里去吧！

text_en: When evening came, the owner of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and give them their pay, beginning with the last and then going to the first. ’
text_cn: 到了晚上，葡萄园的主人对他的管事人说：你叫工人来，分给他们工资，由最后的开始，直到最先的。

text_en: When those hired about five o’clock came, each of them received the usual daily wage.
text_cn: 那些约在第十一时辰来的人，每人领了一个“德纳”。

text_en: Now when the first came, they thought they would receive more; but each of them also received the usual daily wage.
text_cn: 那些最先雇的前来，心想自己必会多领；但他们也只领了一个“德纳”。

text_en: And when they received it, they grumbled against the landowner,
text_cn: 他们一领了，就抱怨家主，

text_en: saying, ‘These last worked only one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat. ’
text_cn: 说：这些最后雇的人，不过工作了一个时辰，而你竟把他们与我们这整天受苦受热的同等看待。

text_en: But he replied to one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong; did you not agree with me for the usual daily wage?
text_cn: 他答复其中的一个说：朋友！我并没有亏负你，你不是和我议定了一个“德纳”吗？

text_en: Take what belongs to you and go; I choose to give to this last the same as I give to you.
text_cn: 拿你的走吧！我愿意给最后来的和给你的一样。

text_en: Am I not allowed to do what I choose with what belongs to me? Or are you envious because I am generous? ’
text_cn: 难道不许我拿我所有的财物，行我所愿意的吗？或是因为我好，你就眼红吗？

text_en: So the last will be first, and the first will be last. ”
text_cn: 这样，最后的，将成为最先的，最先的将会成为最后的。”

text_en: While Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside by themselves, and said to them on the way,
text_cn: 耶稣上耶路撒冷去，暗暗把十二个门徒带到一边，在路上对他们说：

text_en: “See, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be handed over to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death;
text_cn: “看，我们上耶路撒冷去，人子要被交于司祭和经师，他们要定他的死罪；

text_en: then they will hand him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and flogged and crucified; and on the third day he will be raised. ”
text_cn: 并且要把他交给外邦人戏弄、鞭打、钉死；但第三天，他要复活。”

text_en: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, and kneeling before him, she asked a favor of him.
text_cn: 那时，载伯德儿子的母亲，同自己的儿子前来，叩拜耶稣， 请求他一件事。

text_en: And he said to her, “What do you want? ” She said to him, “Declare that these two sons of mine will sit, one at your right hand and one at your left, in your kingdom. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对她说：“你要什么？”她回答说：“你叫我的这两个儿子，在你王国内，一个坐在你的右边，一个坐在你的左边。”

text_en: But Jesus answered, “You do not know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink? ” They said to him, “We are able. ”
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“你们不知道你们所求的是什么，你们能饮我将要饮的爵吗？ 他们说：“我们能。”

text_en: He said to them, “You will indeed drink my cup, but to sit at my right hand and at my left, this is not mine to grant, but it is for those for whom it has been prepared by my Father. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“我的爵你们固然要饮；但坐在右边或左边，不是我可以给的，而是我父给谁预备了，就给谁。”

text_en: When the ten heard it, they were angry with the two brothers.
text_cn: 那十个听了，就恼怒他们两兄弟。

text_en: But Jesus called them to him and said, “You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their great ones are tyrants over them.
text_cn: 耶稣叫过他们来说：“你们知道：外邦人有首长主宰他们，有大臣管辖他们。

text_en: It will not be so among you; but whoever wishes to be great among you must be your servant,
text_cn: 在你们中却不可这样；谁若愿意在你们中成为大的，就当作你们的仆役；

text_en: and whoever wishes to be first among you must be your slave;
text_cn: 谁若愿意在你们中为首，就当作你们的奴仆。

text_en: just as the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life a ransom for many. ”
text_cn: 就如人子来不是受服事，而是服事人，并交出自己的生命，为大众作赎价。”

text_en: As they were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed him.
text_cn: 他们由耶里哥出来时，有许多群众跟随耶稣。

text_en: There were two blind men sitting by the roadside. When they heard that Jesus was passing by, they shouted, “Lord, have mercy on us, Son of David! ”
text_cn: 有两个瞎子坐在路旁，听说耶稣路过，就喊叫说：“主，达味之子，可怜我们吧！”民众斥责他们，

text_en: The crowd sternly ordered them to be quiet; but they shouted even more loudly, “Have mercy on us, Lord, Son of David! ”
text_cn: 叫他们不要作声；他们反而更喊叫说：“主，达味之子，可怜我们吧！”

text_en: Jesus stood still and called them, saying, “What do you want me to do for you? ”
text_cn: 耶稣就站住，叫过他们来，说：“你们愿意我给你们作什么？”

text_en: They said to him, “Lord, let our eyes be opened. ”
text_cn: 他们回答说：“主，叫我们的眼睛开开吧！”

text_en: Moved with compassion, Jesus touched their eyes. Immediately they regained their sight and followed him.
text_cn: 耶稣动了慈心，摸了摸他们的眼睛；他们就立刻看见了，也跟着他去了。
